probes.benchmark: bst (tuned: n=64, seed=17; research/agy/wave4_bench/inputs/tuned/kernels/bst.bend + driver.bend; reps=256000 for both b5k and C, normalized to fixed_reps=27184)

variants.name: a_sorted_fold_inline_unspill
variants.note: Patched $direct.sorted_fold ONLY (256 iters/call, 4x collect): (1) inline repeat_key as a tight inner loop using lea (*10) — previously 1-step peeling left an out-of-line `callq $direct.repeat_key` with n=0 on every non-zero bucket (~60 calls/bench!), (2) keep arr_ptr/arr_mask/left/h in registers instead of spilling all 4 to [rbp-] on every iteration, (3) hoist the loop-invariant array null-check out of the loop. Alone saves 38.3% (1.62x -> 1.167x C).

variants.name: b_collect_magic_mod257_addl
variants.note: Patched $direct.collect ONLY (64 iters/call): replace 16-insn mod-257 reduction with 9-insn magic multiply (`imul $0xff00ff01; shr $40; shl $8; add; sub`), hoist array null-check, and fuse `mov; add $1; mov` into 32-bit `addl $1, (%r10,%rdi,8)`.

variants.name: ab_sorted_fold_plus_collect
variants.note: Within 5.1% of gcc-10 -O2 (1.051x C; 1.80x speedup, 44.4% saved) even while keeping Bend's 4 KiB heap-allocated 512-slot array zeroing vs C's 1 KiB stack uint32_t[257]!

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (inline small self-TCO helper loops instead of 1-step peel+call + unspill hoisted array ptr/mask/loop-vars + 32-bit addl RMW + magic mod: 1.80x -> 1.051x C)
probes.estimated_loc: ~120 LOC (~50 LOC inline small TCO inner loop + lea *10, ~40 LOC hoist array null-check & keep ptr/mask in regs, ~30 LOC 32-bit addl RMW + magic mod-257)

variants.name: a_count_addl_unspill_hoist
variants.note: Patched $direct.count.go ONLY: (1) fuse 64-bit `lea; mov (%rdi),%rax; add $1,%eax; mov %rax,(%rdi)` into 32-bit `addl $1, (%r10,%rax,8)`, (2) unspill both array masks (`-0x40(%rbp)` and `-0x48(%rbp)`) into registers, (3) hoist both loop-invariant `test %r10/%r11` null-checks out of the loop, (4) bottom-tested loop (`sub $1; jne`). Alone saves 22.5% (1.29x -> 1.459x C).

variants.name: b_fill_hoist_imm_bottom
variants.note: Patched $direct.fill.go ONLY: hoist `test %r10` null-check out of loop, use 32-bit immediate `imul $0x9e3779b1, %eax, %eax` instead of reloading constant into %esi every iter, and bottom-tested loop.

variants.name: ab_count_plus_fill
variants.note: Combined $direct.count.go + $direct.fill.go saves 28.9% (1.41x -> 1.338x C; on clean runs 41.1 ms vs 30.8 ms C). Remaining ~10.5 ms gap is Bend's 8-byte-per-U32 Array layout (2x memory footprint: 2 MiB vs 1 MiB for ks) plus zero.go/col.go/fork-join overhead.

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (32-bit addl RMW + unspill hoisted array masks + hoist array null-checks + bottom-tested loops: 1.41x -> 1.338x C)
probes.estimated_loc: ~75 LOC (~20 LOC 32-bit addl RMW emission, ~35 LOC hoist array null-check & keep masks in regs, ~20 LOC immediate imul + bottom-tested loop)

probes.benchmark: bench/runtime/lexer/main.bend (scaled DEPTH=19; 524288 lines generated and tokenized)

variants.name: a_lex_unboxed_mode
variants.note: Patched $direct.lex ONLY: unbox Mode (`Gap`/`InId{h}`/`InNm{v}`) and `(Mode, U32)` Pair into 2 registers `(mode_tag, mode_val)`, eliminating ~40M heap Mode+Pair alloc/free pairs and p111_program/p111_cid_hot checks while still walking and freeing the heap SCon String cons-list. Alone saves 21.4% (1.27x).

variants.name: b_ident_num_magic_div
variants.note: Patched $direct.ident + $direct.num ONLY: replace 64-bit hardware `div %rcx` by 26 (`ident`) and 10 (`num`) with magic multiply (`0x4ec4ec4f >> 35` and `0xcccccccd >> 35`), convert recursive cons-building to iterative, and drop per-SCon p111_program/p111_cid_hot checks. Alone saves 14.8% (1.17x).

variants.name: ab_lex_plus_ident_num
variants.note: Combined $direct.lex + $direct.ident + $direct.num saves 27.1% (1.37x; 872-892 ms on clean runs).

variants.name: abc_plus_static_tpl_gen
variants.note: CRITICAL FINDING: $direct.batch inlined $direct.line, which allocated 39 heap SCon nodes for the constant string literal `tpl()` on EVERY line (20.4M wasted SCon nodes!) and ran hardware `div` by 6 in $direct.gen. Placing constant string literals in .rodata + magic `% 6` (while STILL materializing the full ~75-node heap SCon String for $direct.lex!) delivers 1.79x speedup (44.1% saved -> 5.52x C; 755 ms clean). Remaining gap vs C's 140 ms is the cons-list String representation (~40M heap SCon nodes vs C's 75-byte stack char buffer).

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (general const U32 div/mod magic multiply + small-ADT state unboxing in TCO loops + static .rodata constant string literals: 1.79x -> 5.52x C without changing String representation)
probes.estimated_loc: ~210 LOC (~60 LOC general u32 const div/mod magic multiply, ~90 LOC small-ADT/Pair unboxing in TCO loops, ~60 LOC static .rodata string literals)

probes.benchmark: bench/runtime/hashmap/main.bend (scaled TABLES=9, KEYS=16384; 512 independent 4096-bucket separate-chaining tables)

variants.name: a_has_borrow_walk
variants.note: CRITICAL BUG/GAP FOUND: in $direct.has, the shared-ctor fast-path checks `(field0 | field1) >> 57 != 0`, which is ALWAYS TRUE for `CCons{h, t}` because `t` is a Chain ctor (tag 0x82 or 0x02)! Thus 100% of CCons nodes fell back to out-of-line `callq p111_rt_take`! Walking the Chain read-only (borrowing all internal nodes: 0 p111_rt_take, 0 internal rc++/rc--, dropping original head `c` once at exit) alone saves 20.4% (1.26x).

variants.name: ab_has_plus_look_borrow
variants.note: Also hoist arr_ptr/mask and borrow `arr[b]` directly in $direct.look (eliminating 8.4M Array.get RC++ / has RC-- pairs + inline has-walk + hoisted `s * 340573321`). Saves 25.2% total (1.34x).

variants.name: abc_plus_fill_borrow_fast_cons
variants.note: Also patch $direct.fill: hoist arr_ptr/mask, borrow `arr[b]` for read-only has-walk (0 Array.get RC++), and on miss allocate CCons + 1-word RC box inline from free[1]/free[0] moving old `arr[b]` directly into `t` (0 Array.set RC--, 0 p111_rt_keep/op, 0 p111_program/p111_cid_hot checks). Cuts 45.5% of total runtime (1.83x -> 3.31x C; 989 ms clean). Remaining gap vs C's 302 ms is sweep/len + recursive drop of 8.4M boxed CCons+RC-box nodes vs C's flat index-linked uint32_t pool.

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (read-only borrow-walk for Data match + borrowing Array.get/set fusion in loops + removing p111_program/p111_cid_hot hot checks: 1.83x -> 3.31x C)
probes.estimated_loc: ~180 LOC (~80 LOC read-only borrow-walk on recursive Data match, ~100 LOC borrowing Array.get + fused Array.set move in loops)

probes.benchmark: bench/runtime/merkle/main.bend (scaled SIZE=18, BLOCKS=30, PROBE=1337; 2^18 leaves x 30 Speck32/64 blocks x 22 rounds)

variants.name: a_spk_lut_rol
variants.note: BEATS gcc-10 -O2 by 14.2% (0.858x C; 6.61x speedup, 84.9% saved)! SMOKING GUN: $direct.spk inlined `rk(j)` as a 22-way sequential `cmp/jne` branch chain inside the 22-round Speck inner loop (173M iters at SIZE=18, 2.77B at SIZE=22)! Replacing the 22-way chain with a .rodata `uint16_t rk_tbl[22]` LUT + 16-bit `rorw $7` / `rolw $2` + zero-frame bottom-tested loop obliterates 84.9% of runtime and eliminates the >30s timeout at SIZE=22 (~52s -> ~7.9s vs 9.07s C)!

variants.name: b_blk_inline_spk
variants.note: CRUSHES gcc-10 -O2 by 43.2% (0.568x C; 9.97x speedup, 90.0% saved)! Also inlining $direct.spk into $direct.blk eliminates 7.86M function calls and hoists the rk_tbl pointer across all 30 blocks per leaf.

probes.verdict: STRONG GO (dense Nat-match -> .rodata LUT + 16-bit rotate pattern recognition + small-loop inlining: 6.61x -> 0.858x C, 9.97x -> 0.568x C, eliminates SIZE=22 timeout)
probes.estimated_loc: ~150 LOC (~80 LOC dense Nat-match -> .rodata LUT [same pass as Wave 3 raytrace!], ~30 LOC 16-bit rorw/rolw pattern recognition, ~40 LOC small self-TCO loop inlining)
